SELECT pp.id AS policyId, pp.perm_id AS permId, pp.status AS policyStatus, pp.access_type AS accessType, pp.field_operates AS fieldOperates, pp.table_name AS tableName, pp.target_type AS targetType, p.perm_code AS permCode FROM sys_perm_policy pp INNER JOIN sys_perm p ON pp.perm_id = p.id AND p.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED' WHERE pp.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED' AND (
(pp.target_type = 'ROLE' AND pp.target_id IN ( SELECT rp.id FROM sys_role_policy rp INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = rp.role_id AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED' WHERE rp.target_type = 'USER' AND rp.target_id = #{userPolicyId} AND rp.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED' AND rp.status = 'ACTIVE' )) OR
(pp.target_type = 'USER' AND pp.target_id = #{userPolicyId}) )
